articles.title: Head of Swiss euthanasia firm dies while climbing Mount Fuji; 99-year-old woman rescued - CBS News
articles.description: A Swiss man died after losing consciousness hiking up Mount Fuji, marking the second fatality in one week on the iconic mountain.
articles.content:
